title: Snake: pause + high score
prompt:
The attached ZIP is an existing Snake game (index.html, src/game.js, README.md) imported as the starting point. Keep every existing behaviour and API and add: (1) Pause: Game.input.togglePause(), the P key and Escape toggle it, and an on-canvas pause button of at least 24x24 CSS px toggles it by tap or click; while paused the snake does not move, step() changes nothing and turns are ignored; pausing works only in phase 'play' and start() unpauses. (2) High score: the best score is read from localStorage key 'kyora-snake-best' on page load and in start(), written whenever a game ends with a new best, and never lowered. Show score, high score and a pause overlay on the canvas.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, length, head:{x,y}, dir, food:{x,y}, cols, rows, ticksPerMove, paused, highScore}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.turn(dir): unchanged
- Game.debug.setFood(x, y): unchanged
- Game.input.togglePause(): toggle pause
- Game.pauseButtonRect(): {x, y, w, h} of the pause button in canvas CSS px

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): old behaviour intact; pause by API, keys and button; high score saved, loaded, never lowered.
